summary: Have fun designing amazing cars and run races with Tiny Friends!
description:
Participate in the funniest car race with your custom cars!
This car racing game is aimed at children aged between 3 and 6 years old to enhance their creativity and stimulate fine motor skills.

Children can select their favorite character and create amazing cars from the garage. Oscar, Lila, Coco and Pepper are the characters that will accompany them during the game while they paint and color the cars and avoid obstacles in the race.

DESIGN YOUR FAVORITE CAR IN THE GARAGE

- Choose your favorite character and a car model you want to play with
- Design your own vehicles with paints, stickers and accessories
- Paint and color with different types of brushes, markers and sprays
- Change the wheels and tires of the car with special designs

CHOOSE THE RACE TYPE

- Select the theme you like best: mountain, candy world, space or city.
- Within each category there are several car racing scenarios.
- Dodge obstacles, cross the ramps and sliding areas without your car overturning.
- Compete with the rest of the participants in the race and be the first to reach the finish.

DIFFERENT CAR MODELS

Within the game children can choose different car models, divided into four categories:

- Field: tractor, truck, excavator...
- Special cars: Cadillac, beetle, carriage, hippie van...
- High speed: Race car, rocket, spaceship...
- Public transport: Fire truck, ambulance, police car, bus, taxi...

TINY FRIENDS
Meet your new virtual friends with whom you will have a great time!

Oscar: very responsible and affectionate with everyone. His friends say he has the soul of a leader because of his ability to observe and overcome different challenges with patience, without ever losing his temper. Oscar is obsessed with puzzles and numbers. Science, in general, is his great passion. 

Lila: Fun is guaranteed with Lila! This sweet doll spreads her joy to everyone. Lila is also smart and very creative. She likes to draw and paint while listening to music. She often ends up singing at the top of her lungs and learning to play different musical instruments - a real artist! 

Coco: Coco loves nature. Another of her passions is reading and learning new things every day. She is a bit introverted but inspires great affection. He usually prepares delicious recipes for his family and friends and takes care of every last detail.

Pepper: Pepper's energy never runs out. He loves sports and all kinds of games. He enjoys overcoming different challenges and is very competitive, he doesn't like to lose. His humor and way of being makes everyone laugh
